title: Records of Processing Activities
subtitle: Manage your Article 30 compliance records and data processing activities.
empty_state: No processing activities found. Create your first record to begin.

editor.ai_suggested_data: AI suggested {count} data categories. Apply them in the Data Categories tab.
editor.regulatory_impacts_notice: {count} regulatory update(s) may affect this activity. Review updates →

general.title: General Information
general.purpose_ph: Describe exactly why this processing occurs...
general.client_assignment_desc: Select which clients this processing activity serves. It will appear on their compliance portals.
general.systematic_monitoring_desc: Processing involves regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale.
general.status_publish_hint: An activity becomes active through Publish, once its record answers Article 30.
general.business_owner_hint: Who knows what this activity actually does day to day.
general.privacy_owner_hint: Who answers for it under Article 5(2).

legal.title: Legal Basis Configuration
legal.lia_desc: You must conduct and document an LIA when relying on legitimate interests.
legal.role_controller: Controller — we decide why and how
legal.role_joint_controller: Joint controller — we decide jointly with another
legal.role_processor: Processor — we act on another organisation’s instructions
legal.role_hint: Article 30(1) is the controller’s record; Article 30(2) is the processor’s. They require different information.
legal.controller_name_hint: Required by Article 30(2)(a) for every processor record.

retention.title: Data Retention Policy
retention.justification_ph: Explain why this data must be kept for this period (e.g., statutory requirements, business needs)...
retention.deletion_procedure_ph: How is this data securely destroyed at the end of its lifecycle?
retention.custom_ph: e.g. 7 years after the end of the employment relationship

security.title: Technical & Organizational Measures (TOMs)
security.additional_notes_ph: Describe any other specific technical or organizational measures...

editor.not_found_description: The requested processing activity could not be loaded.

completeness.title: Record completeness
completeness.complete: Every requirement that applies to this activity is answered.
completeness.complete_detail: Nothing outstanding. The record answers each Article 30 limb that applies to it.

gate.title: This record cannot be published yet
gate.description: Publishing marks an activity as an active Article 30 record. These requirements are unanswered.
gate.exception_ph: E.g. Published ahead of the September audit with the DPO's agreement; Finance is confirming the retention period.
gate.exception_hint: The reason is stored with your name and the date, and shown on the record. An override that is not written down is not an override.

adm.title: Profiling and automated decisions
adm.subtitle: Article 22. Only asked about further if this activity makes decisions without a person in the loop.
adm.profiling_desc: Article 4(4) — automated evaluation of personal aspects such as performance, preferences, behaviour or location.
adm.solely_automated: Decisions are made solely by automated means
adm.solely_automated_desc: With legal or similarly significant effects. Article 22(1) prohibits this unless 22(2)(a)-(c) applies.
adm.logic_ph: How the decision is reached, in terms a data subject could follow.
adm.logic_hint: Articles 13(2)(f) and 14(2)(g) require meaningful information about the logic — not the source code, but not "an algorithm" either.
adm.significance_ph: What the decision determines for the person it is about.
adm.human_intervention_ph: Who can review the outcome, how a subject reaches them, and what they can change.
adm.human_intervention_hint: Article 22(3) requires the right to obtain human intervention, to express a point of view and to contest the decision.

empty.title: No processing activities yet
empty.description: Your Article 30 register lists every purpose you process personal data for. Add the first activity, or import a register you already keep.

record.subtitle: Full record — Article 30
record.name: Name
record.no_data_subjects: No categories of data subject recorded.
record.no_data_categories: No categories of personal data recorded.
record.national_law: Union or Member State law relied on
record.no_recipients: No recipients recorded. Nothing about this activity is disclosed outside the organisation.
record.no_transfers: No transfers outside the EEA recorded.
record.retention_note: Where a data category carries its own retention rule, that rule governs it. This is the fallback for anything that does not.
record.no_security: No technical or organisational measures recorded.
